# Clavis Encrypt 3.9.3

## 🎁 Trial keys

- Clavis Encrypt now accepts the new trial and gift keys we send to testers and reviewers. They unlock Pro or Premium on one PC for a set number of days; when the trial ends, the app simply returns to Free and your files and vaults stay exactly as they are.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
